info.title: fergi
info.description: The fergi command line (dotnet tool): validate and run mapping files. .NET only (it references Fergi.Jsonata).

commands.name: run
commands.description:
Run a mapping over input files and write one output
file.

options.name: --input
options.description:
A single-file input: name=file, or just a file (the
name is then the file name without its extension).
Repeat for more inputs.

options.name: --input-list
options.description:
A list input (the mapping's inputLists): name=file.
Repeat to add files in order. The file may be a glob
(* and ?), expanded sorted by path.

options.name: --output
options.description:
The file to write. Format follows the extension
(.yaml, .yml, .json). It may not be an input or the
mapping.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
Print what would change in the output; write nothing.
help                  display this list of options.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Check a mapping file without running it.
